entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be monitored for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi. I need to return some cycling shoes I bought last week. They don't fit right.
Okay, I can help you with that. Can I get your order number please?
Thank you. I see the order here. It includes a pair of VeloFit Pro Series cycling shoes. Before I process the return, have you by any chance... *mounted* any cleats on them?
Yeah, I *installed* cleats. I had to try them out, right? How else would I know they didn't fit?
I understand, sir. And these shoes, did you use them at all? I'm asking because I notice you also ordered tires, have they been *mounted* as well?
I took them for one ride, yeah. The shoes felt too tight after about 20 minutes. And yeah, the tires, too. Just around the block, though.

I see. Unfortunately, because the shoes have *cleat marks* and the tires are technically *dirty tires*, we are unable to accept the return. Items must be in new and unused condition for a full refund.
What? That's ridiculous! I barely used them! I had to try them on the bike! I can't tell if shoes fit just by looking at them!

I understand your frustration, but due to the *cleat marks* and the fact that they've been *mounted*, and the tires were *installed*, they are no longer considered new. We *cannot resell* them as new, and our return policy is very clear about this.

So you're telling me I'm stuck with these shoes that don't fit, and tires I tested for two seconds? This is insane! You guys should warn people about this before they buy! What am I supposed to do with them?
Sir, I apologize for the inconvenience. While I cannot process a return in this case, I can offer you a 10% discount on your next purchase.
A 10% discount? Are you serious? That doesn't even cover the shipping I paid! This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced!
I understand your frustration, sir. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You know what? Forget it! This is a waste of my time!
Sir? Sir, are you still there?
